name: Folio Riwaq
summary: Two curling Quran leaves become the wide, open foundation of an ogee mosque.
why: The book gutter, dome, and doorway share x=54. Both curved page apertures mirror each other; the mosque body physically overlaps their upper edges. The single minaret joins the left leaf, so every element belongs to the same structure.
risk: The wide page silhouette makes Quran reading prominent. At 24px the curved page openings become small but the central mosque remains readable.
sub1: Curved leaves carry the prayer hall
theme: An arabesque mosque growing from Quran pages
reasonToChoose: You want prayer and Quran reading to feel like one continuous identity.

palette.name: FOLIO RIWAQ / DEEP TEAL + CREAM + APRICOT
